build_get_dataset_kitti: build a dataset pipeline using get_dataset with KITTI_Raw+MV_2stage configuration for flow estimation training
build_get_dataset_sintel: build a dataset pipeline using get_dataset with Sintel_Raw+ft_2stage configuration for flow estimation training
create_concat_dataset_kitti: create a ConcatDataset combining KITTI2015 and KITTI2012 flow datasets for multi-view training
create_transforms_pipeline: create input and co-transforms pipelines for KITTI or Sintel flow dataset loading
test_get_dataset_sintel_validation: test get_dataset with Sintel clean and final splits for validation with ground truth flow
